I got in a small accident the previous Friday, which ended up throwing off the alignment to my tires a lot (think holding the wheel at the 3o'clock position to go straight). Also my muffler needed replacing from general rust. I was recommended big o from someone I knew, and decided that even though it's a bit of a hike, I would use them. Dropped my truck off in the morning and asked them to call me with an quote before beginning the work, just to make sure I could cover it. I got a call the same morning and was told it would be 525.63 for the muffler system and they would do the alignment for free. When asked how long it would take, the man on the phone said that the parts would be in the same day (Tuesday), and the repairs would be done "by the end of the day Tuesday, or Wednesday at the latest". Wednesday evening comes and I head to my second job just down the street, where I had planned to pick up my truck after work. One of the guys was leaving just as I clocked in, so I asked if he could take my card over and pay them and snag my key if they were done. When he came back, I looked at my receipt and saw it said 583.76. It's not a huge difference, but it was definitely more than i was told. Then I was also told that my truck wasn't even in the bay yet and they hadn't done the work. I called them to inquire about the extra charge and why the work wasn't even started yet, especially because they said it would be done at the latest that night. The same guy told me that they needed to get some clamps and whatnot and that tax wasn't added to the quote. I was a little cross at this point, and asked why it wasn't done, and when it would be. The guy gave me a bit of a run around, then said they were busy and left it at that. Thursday evening comes and I head out to pick up my truck. I've probably paid around 75$ in extra cab fare for getting to and from both of my jobs for an extra day. I get to the shop, pick up my truck and am just glad to have it back. I start driving down the road and smell this burnt plastic smell inside the cab, and more importantly notice my alignment was now screwed up the exact opposite direction - the wheel being held in the 10o'clock position to go straight. I drive back and ask Jason why the alignment was now off in the opposite direction. He told me that he's sorry but there isn't anything he can do right now, but if I leave it there they should have it fixed by Friday. I told him that's ridiculous, you already promised me it would be fixed at the latest yesterday (Wed), and now I have to wait another day? He said they were very busy and they don't make promises over the phone on when the work will be done. He then went on to say that I could even bring it back Monday and the alignment would be fixed for free. I told him that I cant afford to keep using uber or lyft to get back and forth for another day to two different jobs. He said that it was the only thing he could do. I was already flustered about the whole situation, so I just took my truck and will just go to a different shop after the holidays. It's not worth trying deal with them again. I must add though, the guy who did the exhaust work did a good job. Unfortunately the customer service i received from the front desk person Jason, his lack of follow up, and not even finishing the work they were paid to do is just infuriating. EDIT 1: I decided to edit this a few days after the fact in order to clarify my point, and more importantly to bring up something I found problematic. I noticed a review on their website that contained false information. It raises the question of how credible their reviews are and if, in fact, they are written by their staff and not customers. EDIT6/8/17: I would like to rescind my earlier statement that the exhaust work was well done. I was driving on Tuesday when the entire back half of the exhaust system they installed fell off. A different shop told me the original work was simply a "half-a**ed job". Please do not use this shop, brand new parts should not break after 6 months
